Detailed Description

This API is a Monitoring Report API which the AWR device sends to the host, containing the measured TX phase shifter DAC monitoring results during an explicit monitoring chirp. The AWR device sends this to host at the programmed periodicity or when failure occurs, as programmed by the configuration API SB. Event: RL_RF_AE_MON_ADV_TX_PHSHIFTER_DAC_REPORT.
